findings.text: the version-keyed reader contract is wrong in both directions: schema-3 rows already carry the engine section and a numeric flat prefix_cache_hits_total, the rows carrying a numeric flat prefix_cache_hit_rate are the pre-schema files with no schema_version key at all (114,717 rows of deepseek-v4-flash-1264576.jsonl), and schema-3 flat rate and interval are null in every row, so the advice sends a reader to the rows where the flat columns are empty and away from the rows where they hold values.

_prefix_hit_rate differences the current row's engine counters against the previous row's with no job, host or boot identity, so a window interleaving two counter-family serves emits a rate no serve measured — measured on the head module, previous 4,000,000 hits / 500,000 queries and current 5,000,000 / 4,000,000 yields 0.2857 because the guard only refuses a non-positive advance; latent today, since no recorded row carries an engine section from a counter-only family.

the refusal of a non-positive advance is held by no test: deleting the branch leaves tests/test_agent_receipt_bins.py at 3 passed, while a positive control forcing every rate to zero reddens all three, so the suite binds the function's output and not this branch.

the schema-version bit is asserted against the constant under test at 671, 869 and 1344, payload["schema_version"] == sr.ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION, so no test reddens if the value reverts to 3 and the distinguishing bit the version exists to carry is held by nothing.

item_verdicts.diff: the change does what it says where the corpus can test it; the one behaviour it adds, reader-side differencing of engine counters, carries a serve-provenance gap that its own guard does not catch.
item_verdicts.done_when: all five items hold and each was reproduced independently — four-file gate 94 passed against 91 collected at base 913bd953, ruff exit 0, serving-interpreter guard 1 passed, the declared mutation reddens exactly the named watch test (1 failed of 14, replayed through a sys.modules shadow so the reviewed tree was untouched), and the live-row statement re-derived against job 1273253 on port 18810.
item_verdicts.goal: the ten flat columns are removed and every consumer verified; on the recorded corpus the removed interval and rate columns carried a value in zero rows and the one removed column that carried values, prefix_cache_hit_delta at 1,269 rows, is recoverable by differencing the engine counts the same rows still state, so the goal is met without losing recorded information.
item_verdicts.manifest: accurate on every measured field with one exception — the version-keyed reader contract it states matches no recorded population, so a reader following it looks in the wrong place.
item_verdicts.write_paths: one edited file sits outside the declared list, tests/test_agent_receipt_bins.py, because the declared name tests/test_receipt_bins.py does not exist; the edit is confined to that file's own content and the fence's consumer list requires receipt_bins coverage, so the substantive scope is respected and the mismatch is reported rather than hidden.

justifications.durability: the added assertions are mutation-sensitive and the refuse-on-backwards branch is not — deleting it leaves the bins suite at 3 passed while a positive control that forces every rate to zero reddens all three.
justifications.evidence: every gate claim reproduced at the reviewed revision and the live-row claim re-derived on the running serve, with the one gap that the live-row numbers exist only as prose.
justifications.fit: the rate-assembly rule now exists in two places, watch.py and receipt_bins.py, with one refusing a non-positive advance and the other unguarded, which is the divergence the duplication invites.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the removal is complete and lossless on the corpus, but the manifest's reader contract describes a version-keyed population split that no recorded row exhibits.
justifications.scope_discipline: the single out-of-list path is the file the fence's own consumer requires, and the discrepancy is disclosed instead of silently renamed.
